name: Chikyuu Bouei-tai Star Guardians
original_name: 地球防衛隊スターガーディアンズ
source:
Porin of the Star Guardians brought a treasure back to the earth 
making her escape from an evil institution called Destopian.
Having lived on the earth for months, her peaceful life is suddenly 
interrupted by a villain from Destopian, Anemone.
Thus, she is thrown into days of battle once more, this time on the earth...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE233623.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
星辰守护者波琳从邪恶机构“毁灭之托邦”逃出，带回一件宝物。在地球上生活数月后，她平静的生活突然被毁灭之托邦的恶棍海葵打断。于是，她再次被卷入战斗，而这一次战场就在地球……

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE233623.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
